who.name: WHO, Household air pollution fact sheet (16 December 2025)
who.facts: 2.9 million deaths a year linked to household air pollution in 2021, including more than 309,000 children under five; women and children carry most of the burden of cooking and fuel collection, which takes time from school and work.

sdg7.name: IEA, IRENA, UNSD, World Bank and WHO, Tracking SDG 7: The Energy Progress Report 2026
sdg7.facts: 655 million people without electricity and about 2.0 billion relying on polluting cooking fuels in 2024.

apaec.name: ASEAN Centre for Energy, ASEAN Plan of Action for Energy Cooperation (APAEC) 2026-2030
apaec.facts: Endorsed at the 43rd ASEAN Ministers on Energy Meeting, October 2025. Seven programme areas: ASEAN Power Grid; oil and gas connectivity, security and sustainability; clean coal transformation; energy efficiency and conservation; renewable energy; regional energy policy and planning; civilian nuclear energy. Energy access is addressed in general terms; there is no programme area for clean cooking.
